subject: gov.policy
name: AU Data Policy Framework (AUDPF) — national adoption process
milestone: Data Governance Capacity Building Workshop held (9-10 Jul 2026), D4D Hub with GIZ, AUDA-NEPAD, KICTANET
position_end: Workshop held on national AUDPF adoption; translation into policy/institutional reform is the stated goal, not yet delivered
sources: 2026-07-13 D4D Hub on Sao Tome and Principe

subject: gov.policy
name: CST ON IPTV provisional authorisation (Resolucao 003/CA/AGER/2026)
milestone: AGER Conselho de Administracao approves Resolucao 003/CA/AGER/2026
position_end: CST provisionally authorised to carry IPTV over its CST ON platform, stated by the regulator as diversifying electronic communications services
note: The page is undated; the year is taken from the resolution number carried in the body

subject: gov.policy
name: INIC national web-hosting service and the data-residency position
milestone: Hosting offered to the whole public administration, with private bodies invited
position_end: INIC states that storing and hosting the country's vital information and systems in national territory is an imperative of security and sovereignty, and that the personal data protection law restricts hosting personal information outside the country
note: The INIC page is undated; the year is inferred at year precision from retrieval

subject: gov.policy
name: National AI strategy (Lei da Estrategia Nacional de IA)
milestone: UNESCO readiness assessment records none and recommends approval by 2027/2028
position_end: No national artificial-intelligence strategy exists. The readiness assessment's own roadmap puts approval of a National AI Strategy Law at 2027 or 2028 and rates it low priority, arguing the instrument must be a law because personal-rights matters are reserved to the National Assembly, and assigns it to the innovation institute, the data protection agency, the minister of the presidency and the Assembly; ahead of it the roadmap rates updating the data protection agency's 2017 organic law, the 2008 decree creating the innovation institute and the 2020 resolution adopting the digital governance strategy as high priority for 2024 or 2025
note: the education minister's preface states the country is not prepared to implement artificial intelligence ethically, having neither a strategy nor any AI-specific law nor a national AI ethics commission

subject: gov.policy
name: National data strategy and implementation roadmap (INIC)
milestone: Version 1 published by INIC, July 2025, under a technical-assistance contract
position_end: Version 1 published: objectives for responsible and ethical data use, data-based decision-making and an innovation-oriented culture, with artificial intelligence treated as an opportunity to be explored using public data rather than as anything already in operation

subject: gov.policy
name: National Strategy for Digital Governance (2020)
milestone: Whole-of-government digital-transformation strategy, nine thematic axes, adopted
position_end: Nine-axis framework in force since 2020; UNU-EGOV project-managed
sources: 2024-01-01 National Strategy for Digital Governance in São Tomé and Príncipe
note: Source (UNU-EGOV project page) is undated on-page; year taken from page copyright/context

subject: gov.policy
name: Programme for African Developing Island Economies (AUDA-NEPAD)
milestone: Launched at Ministerial Segment, Abidjan; STP one of seven covered island states
position_end: Programme launched; 2026-2031 roadmap, six pillars incl. digital transformation (DPI, AI/automation, knowledge economy as accelerators); ministerial communique adopted
note: Regional (7-state) programme; STP-specific commitments beyond the communique are not detailed in the source held

subject: gov.policy
name: Public Administration Reform Strategy (2025)
milestone: Justice Minister Vera Cravid presents newly approved strategy naming e-governance its essential pillar
position_end: Strategy approved; e-governance named essential pillar to cut bureaucracy/costs and promote equity of access

subject: gov.policy
name: Quadro Nacional de Interoperabilidade (QNI), version 0.1
milestone: Version 0.1 published on the INIC portal, November 2021
position_end: Draft v0.1 in force as the published framework: definitions, per-dimension policies, a compliance regime, governance and revision arrangements, and mandatory and recommended technical specifications; no later version is held
note: Developed by UNDP and UNU-EGOV with INIC; no approval instrument or successor version is held

subject: gov.legislate
name: Access to information statute
milestone: No statute located; the constitutional articles are the whole of the guarantee
position_end: None published: Artigos 29, 74 and 76 of the constitution guarantee free expression, a duty on office-holders to keep citizens informed and the ineffectiveness of unpublished laws, and none of the three creates a request procedure, deadlines, exemptions, appeal or oversight body

subject: gov.legislate
name: AGER regulatory framework revision (Regulatory Entities Law + Electronic Communications Law)
status: Under review, submitted to National Assembly
milestone: Approved by Council of Ministers, submitted to National Assembly; AGER Statute already approved
position_end: Bills submitted; passage not confirmed in sources held
note: No later source confirms parliamentary passage

subject: gov.legislate
name: Aggregated Identification Document Law (identity law)
status: Under review, drafting/consultation stage flagged urgent
milestone: World Bank mission flags review, public consultation, finalisation and approval as urgent; absence could constrain data collection
position_end: Under review/consultation; passage not confirmed
note: No later source confirms passage

subject: gov.legislate
name: AI-specific legislation or regulation
milestone: UNESCO country profile records no AI law and no national AI ethics commission
position_end: No AI-specific law or regulation is in force. The readiness assessment finds no specific legal provision on artificial intelligence, and identifies the 2016 personal data protection law and the 2017 cybercrime law as the nearest anchors, the latter needing updating to cover artificial intelligence; there is consequently no national AI ethics commission or dedicated governance structure

subject: gov.legislate
name: Lei n. 15/2017 - Lei sobre Cibercrime
milestone: Gazetted in Diario da Republica n. 147 of 6 October 2017, in force 30 days after publication
position_end: In force: creates the computer-crime offences, sets procedural powers of expedited preservation, search, seizure, interception and undercover operations, and requires the Policia Judiciaria to keep a 24/7 international cooperation contact point

subject: gov.legislate
name: Lei n. 17/2018 - Sistema Nacional de Pagamentos
milestone: Enacting law of the national payment system, gazetted 7 September 2018
position_end: In force: applies to payment systems and payment service providers operating in the country, makes the central bank regulator and overseer, and carries a chapter on electronic funds transfers between individuals, commercial entities and financial institutions

subject: gov.legislate
name: Lei n. 5/98 - Bases do Sistema Estatistico Nacional
milestone: Promulgated 31 August 1998, passed by the National Assembly 12 August 1998
position_end: In force: defines the Sistema Estatistico Nacional and its principles, names the Conselho Nacional de Estatistica, the INE and the central bank as its organs, creates the INE in Artigo 7, and sets a regime of statistical transgressions and fines

subject: gov.legislate
name: National Framework for Interoperability (Law 1/2024)
milestone: Law enacted for public-sector data sharing
position_end: In force since 2024; underpins DEX, single citizen portal, trade single window
sources: 2024-01-01 São Tomé and Príncipe - Digital Regulations in the Metaverse Era (Data)
note: Same caveat as the 2016 law — only a secondary legal-survey source held

subject: gov.legislate
name: Personal Data Guarantee and Protection Law (Law 03/2016)
milestone: Gazetted in Diario da Republica n. 39; establishes the ANPDP as supervisory authority
position_end: In force since 2016; fines up to STN 500m for legal entities, criminal sanctions up to 1 year imprisonment for serious breaches
sources: 2016-05-10-sao-tome-lei-03-2016-proteccao-dados-pessoais|2024-01-01 São Tomé and Príncipe - Digital Regulations in the Metaverse Era (Data)
note: The primary gazette text is held as an excerpt, truncated inside Artigo 45

subject: gov.protect
name: ANPDP membership — Rede Lusofona de Protecao de Dados (RLPD)
milestone: CNPD (Portugal)-hosted cooperation visit; network described as 'recem-criada' (recently created)
position_end: Founding member alongside Portugal (CNPD), Angola, Brazil, Cabo Verde; June-2025 visit addressed disinformation, digital violence, video-surveillance, child/youth data training
note: Exact founding date of RLPD (~2024) is not independently sourced; inferred from 'recem-criada' language

subject: gov.protect
name: ANPDP supervision of PReSE registry-CEN data linkage
milestone: ANPDP assigned to supervise the civil-registry/electoral-database interconnection
position_end: Oversight role established; assessment to occur after the interconnection is inspected

subject: gov.protect
name: Macau DSPDP-ANPDP cooperation MoU
milestone: A further agreement on exchanging financial-intelligence information to be signed
position_start: Signing authorised by Macau CE, not yet executed
position_end: MoU signed 1 Jun 2026; STP delegation toured Hong Kong Privacy Commissioner and Guangdong cyber-data-security association; a further agreement between the two jurisdictions on exchanging information to combat money laundering is to be signed, reported 2026-08-24, with no signature date or text on file
note: ; the anti-money-laundering agreement is a second instrument with the same counterpart and is recorded here rather than as a separate row until its text is held

subject: gov.protect
name: Malabo Convention — STP signatory status
milestone: STP signatory status noted in IBA country chapter
position_end: Signatory to the AU Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection; ratification status not established
sources: 2024-01-01 São Tomé and Príncipe - Digital Regulations in the Metaverse Era (Data)

subject: gov.regional
name: ACE submarine cable participation (STP-Cabo SARL)
milestone: World Bank grant closed 2015; participation structured through the STP-Cabo SARL vehicle
position_end: An IDA grant of SDR 9.8 million, US$14.9 million equivalent, financed the country's contribution to the Africa Coast to Europe cable on an open-access basis, with government and CST contributions made into STP-Cabo SARL as a long-term shareholder loan

subject: gov.regional
name: ARCTEL-CPLP and ITU universal connectivity workshop
milestone: Three-day workshop hosted in Sao Tome, November 2025
position_end: Workshop held with CPLP regulators, ITU specialists and national technicians on promoting and measuring universal and meaningful connectivity, closing on a joint commitment to continued technical cooperation and regulatory harmonisation
note: The page is undated; the month is inferred from the reported timing

subject: gov.regional
name: CPLP digital rights charter
milestone: Signed at São Tomé by all nine member states, 19 July 2024
position_end: Expressly declaratory and non-binding, committing members to meaningful connectivity on non-discriminatory and affordable terms, personal data protection, cybersecurity cooperation, digital literacy and capacity building and non-fragmentation of the digital environment, and condemning blanket internet shutdowns; the first named activity in the Lusophone data-governance frame since is a Maputo workshop of 8-10 December 2025 at which UNESCO launched the Portuguese edition of its Data Governance Toolkit and more than 40 data-protection authorities and ICT regulators mapped national data ecosystems and governance gaps against the African Union Data Policy Framework and the Smart Africa Data Governance Blueprint
note: declaratory: no domestic measure is recorded as taken under it

subject: gov.regional
name: Lusophone Africa Data Governance Workshop
milestone: Second workshop held in Luanda, 15-17 Jun 2026
position_end: Second workshop (Luanda, 15-17 Jun 2026): implementation focus — data centres, cloud, interoperability, DPI, institutional governance; STP among 6 participating countries
note: STP's specific national content from this workshop is not detailed; event date (15-17 Jun) is not the publication date (28 Jul)

subject: gov.regional
name: PALOP Digital Governance Dialogues
milestone: Second webinar held (digital ID as foundational DPI)
position_end: Second webinar, 26 Mar 2026, on digital ID/implementation/integration; STP among PALOP participants
note: Multi-country source; STP-specific content not separately detailed

subject: gov.standards
name: SENAPIQ-STP (Servico Nacional da Propriedade Intelectual e Qualidade)
milestone: First bank in the country certified to ISO 9001:2015, August 2026
position_start: A public institute with administrative, financial, technical and asset autonomy under the finance ministry, proposing policies on industrial property, copyright, standardisation, certification and accreditation, and ISO's correspondent member for the country
position_end: The same institutional position, with BGFI Bank Sao Tome becoming the first bank in the country certified to ISO 9001:2015, presented at the ceremony marking 55 years of the BGFI Bank Group

subject: gov.discourse
name: AGER public consultation mechanism
milestone: Cybersecurity strategy put to a 30-day public consultation, September 2025
position_start: One consultation on record, on the draft electronic communications law (Feb 2024), with the regulator's own point-by-point responses published
position_end: A second consultation run, on the 2024-2028 national cybersecurity strategy and its action plan, under the STP Digital project, with contributions due within 30 days and late submissions excluded

subject: gov.discourse
name: FGI STP (Forum de Governanca da Internet)
milestone: 1st edition held, Casa Cacau, 28-30 Jul 2026, opened by the PM
position_end: 1st edition held, regulator (AGER)-convened; agenda covered digital trust, infrastructure, regulation, privacy/data protection, AI, internet/social media; no outcome document or next-edition date published

subject: finance.budget
name: State budget (Orcamento Geral do Estado)
milestone: Lei n. 3/2026 gazetted in Diario da Republica n. 18
position_start: Budget for 2025 published by the Direccao do Orcamento, February 2025
position_end: Budget for 2026 enacted as Lei n. 3/2026; no digital-transformation appropriation line is identified in what the base holds
note: The 2025 document is filed under an approved path but its own title line reads Proposta-OGE 2025

subject: finance.mou
name: China-Sao Tome and Principe strategic partnership
milestone: Elevation to a strategic partnership announced in Beijing, 5 September 2024
position_end: The strategic partnership declaration of 5 September 2024 commits both sides to expanding cooperation into new areas including the digital economy, green development and the blue economy, alongside the traditional fields of agriculture, health and infrastructure; it names no project, no instrument and no sum

subject: finance.new
name: AfDB Payment System Infrastructure and Financial Inclusion Project (PISPIF)
milestone: AfDB commits US$3,335,999 (XDR 2,400,000) grant
position_end: Committed 2017, disbursed US$4,268,636 to date, end year 2027 per IATI record
note: Disbursed figure exceeds committed figure in the source held; no explanation found — treat with caution

subject: finance.new
name: UNICEF PNAD equipment procurement (grant SC220341)
milestone: RFQ_03/2026 open, closes 12 Aug 2026
position_end: Public tender open for 80 tablets + 90 desktops against grant SC220341; no contract value stated
note: Cross-ref capacity.literacy — same instrument

subject: finance.new
name: World Bank 'Digital Sao Tome and Principe' project (P177158)
milestone: US$7.64m disbursed (36%) as of 11 Sep 2025, rated Moderately Satisfactory
position_end: US$7.64m disbursed (36%), Moderately Satisfactory, System Integrator (Ooru) engaged
note: Finances the Digital ID, Citizen Portal, interoperability platform, CSIRT and data-centre work covered above

subject: infra.connect
name: Broadband and mobile internet uptake
milestone: First national broadband-use baseline placed in a financing operation's results framework
position_start: 5,775 fixed broadband subscribers at 2.6 per 100 inhabitants and 96,901 active mobile broadband accesses at 43.3 per 100 (2023)
position_end: 146,000 people using broadband, inferred use, at December 2025, of whom 74,000 women, against targets of 172,000 and 87,000 by December 2028

subject: infra.connect
name: CST national network (antennas/schools expansion)
milestone: 35th antenna inaugurated, Agua Ize, Cantagalo
position_start: Expansion plan to more communities/schools announced, larger schools first
position_end: 35th antenna live at Agua Ize, ending prolonged local network instability

subject: infra.connect
name: CST retail mobile tariff schedule
milestone: Published schedule as read in 2026
movement: No change, a first schedule with no earlier tariff held
position_end: Bundles from 10 Dbs for 24 hours to 330 Dbs for 30 days, the largest carrying 4,000 MB of data
note: The page is undated; the year is inferred from the capture

subject: infra.connect
name: Internet Exchange Point
milestone: Tracker reading as read in 2026: none active, none listed in PeeringDB
position_end: None active and none listed in PeeringDB, with an Internet Resilience Score of 30 out of 100 and 50 per cent of the 1,000 most-visited sites reachable from an in-country server or cache

subject: infra.connect
name: Starlink satellite internet service
milestone: Service activated in STP
position_end: Live: Standard kit STN 5,500 (~US$257); Residential STN 1,700/mo (~US$79.5)

subject: infra.connect
name: Submarine cable to Principe (STP Digital project component)
milestone: Rating for the project development objective cut to moderately satisfactory on cable procurement, October 2025
position_start: Cable progress tracked as a World Bank mission objective, September 2025
position_end: Progress towards the project development objective declined from satisfactory to moderately satisfactory on ongoing challenges with the procurement of the Principe cable, while most other project activities progressed
note: No source held states a build status or a completion date

subject: infra.store
name: GoSTP data-centre modernisation (incl. digital-ID data centre/DR tender)
status: Planned, tender issued, decision not confirmed
milestone: AFAP tenders servers + disaster recovery for the digital-ID data centre
position_start: Three options costed, decision pending, high risk flagged at current sea-level site
position_end: AFAP tender issued for servers + DR, implementing the TIER III/cloud recommendation
note: Tender's own body is an attached PDF, not read; manual clip advised per the dpi-id intersection

subject: infra.energy
name: Decreto-Lei 26/2014 - legal regime of the national electricity sector
milestone: Published in the Diario da Republica, 31 December 2014
position_end: The decree-law organising the national electricity sector, published in the Official Gazette's twelfth supplement of 31 December 2014, is the framework the sector's reform was carried out under and the instrument the regulator and the utility operate beneath
note: held for the record of what governs the sector; the frame asks about grid reliability and rural electrification, which this instrument does not itself measure, so it carries no indicator mapping

subject: infra.energy
name: EMAE generation and network performance
milestone: AfDB approves a US$24.5 million grant anchoring a US$30 million transition project, 23 April 2026
position_start: Available capacity 33.0 MW at 31 December 2024 against 39.0 MW in each of the two prior years, production 60,764 MWh against 103,533 MWh in 2023, combined efficiency 58.5 per cent
position_end: A four-year project approved to build a 4 MWp solar plant with a 2 MWh battery on Principe, rehabilitate low-voltage networks, modernise the national dispatch centre, install over 40,000 prepaid meters and cut non-technical losses from 34 to 20 per cent

subject: infra.energy
name: National Energy Compact (Mission 300)
milestone: Compact target of 100 per cent electricity access by 2030; AfDB grant approved April 2026
position_start: Electricity access rate 84 per cent in 2024, renewable share 3 per cent, private capital mobilisation zero against a target of US$190 million
position_end: Compact targets 100 per cent access by 2030 through grid extension and off-grid mini-grids, and an African Development Fund grant of US$24.5 million was approved in April 2026 anchoring a US$30 million project covering Principe solar, network rehabilitation and 2,000 new connections

subject: infra.energy
name: TESLA STP thermal power investment contract
milestone: Court of Auditors report 02/2025, published 13 May 2025
position_end: The Court of Auditors' compliance and operational audit of the state's administrative investment contract with TESLA STP finds the five installed generators do not hold the 10 MW of capacity the contract defines and have produced roughly 4 MW since installation, while the state is contractually obliged to pay for 10 MW; an investment claim of about 10.85 million euros attributed to the concession is unsubstantiated; customs and tax exemptions granted to the company, its subcontractors, shareholders and group companies cost the state at least 52,282,555 dobras, over 2.13 million euros; and the utility supplied 13,320,198 litres of fuel free of charge between December 2023 and December 2024
note: the 96-page report is held as a scanned artefact with no text layer, so its findings are carried here from contemporaneous reporting on the primary; no state response, recovery or contract amendment is on the record

subject: infra.capacity
name: Government digital capacity, as externally assessed
milestone: World Bank appraisal, May 2022
position_end: A fragmented approach to digitization with most foundations for digital government service delivery still nascent; 155th of 193 on the UN E-Government Index 2020 and 179th of 193 on the E-Participation Index 2018

subject: infra.capacity
name: Sistema de Registo de Embarcacoes de Pesca (FAO, FISH4ACP)
milestone: Two-day training for four agencies at the Direccao-Geral das Pescas, 23-24 April 2026
position_end: Registration moved from paper to an Android application feeding a central database, with technicians of the fisheries directorate, the fisheries inspectorate, the coastguard and the port captaincy trained in registration, consultation, report export and information-security practice, and an FAO user manual left as permanent support

subject: infra.cybersec
name: CSIRT (Computer Security Incident Response Team)
milestone: World Bank mission lists 'launch materialisation of the CSIRT' as a mission objective
position_end: Materialisation launch identified as active mission objective; no operational date or further detail
note: Single line in one mission report; no later source found

subject: infra.cybersec
name: Estrategia Nacional de Ciberseguranca 2024-2028
status: In development, final text drafted, no approval instrument held
milestone: Version 2, final, dated 15 December 2023; put to public consultation September 2025
position_end: The strategy's final text, version 2 of 15 December 2023, was written by an external security firm under a lender-backed project and sets five strategic objectives: strengthening cybersecurity coordination through a Cybersecurity Committee and a national incident response centre, CERT-STP; awareness and a cybersecurity culture; building national capability through training and curricula; consolidating the legal and regulatory structure, which it says lacks any specific legislation on protecting children online; and adopting good practice, including international standards in software and hardware procurement. The committee is to put the strategy to an annual evaluation against yearly performance targets
note: the action plan's tracking grids are blank templates in the document itself, and no adoption instrument, budget or first annual evaluation is held

subject: dpi.exchange
name: legi non (DGRN civil-registry data exchange interface)
milestone: Named by the DGRN as the route for root identification of all Sao Tomeans
position_start: Described by the DGRN as allowing electronic validation of paper documents and machine-to-machine exchange between accredited public administration systems, with no consuming system named
position_end: Biometric enrolment kits tendered for the national digital identity under the Digital STP project, and the social protection additional financing identifying digital-ID linkage as an intended synergy rather than an operating exchange
note: No source names a system currently consuming legi non in production

subject: dpi.exchange
name: Plataforma de Interoperabilidade and Plataforma de Autenticacao
milestone: Mandated by Resolucao n. 35/2020; data-exchange and e-signature prototypes reported live September 2025
position_end: Prototypes live under the Digital STP project's system integrator, against a mandate for an interoperability platform as the structuring layer for public services and an authentication platform on single sign-on integrated with digital identity management and a state certification infrastructure
note: The resolution mandates the platforms; it does not record them as built

subject: dpi.id
name: 'BI para Todos' free national-ID campaign
milestone: Diaspora arm — BIs collectable at STP embassy in Portugal
position_end: Free-BI campaign covering remote localities (Ilheu das Rolas, Porto Alegre, via Starlink-linked mobile brigade) and diaspora collection in Portugal

subject: dpi.id
name: Foundational digital ID (STP Digital/MOSIP, System Integrator Ooru)
status: In development, roadmap not confirmed delivered
milestone: System Integrator Ooru engaged with INIC/DGRN; VCI/DEX/Portal/e-Signature prototypes live; roadmap Jan-May 2026
position_start: Pilot ongoing since 2024, no fixed timeline
position_end: Ooru contracted; live prototypes; roadmap Jan 2026 (ID+Portal) to May 2026 (e-Signature)
sources: 2025-06-05 São Tomé and Principe pilots MOSIP-based national digital ID system|2025-09-17-world-bank-ajuda-memoria-stp-digital-setembro-2025
note: No source held confirms the foundational digital-ID card itself has launched

subject: dpi.id
name: Passport issuance system SEP 2.0
milestone: Non-presential issuance opened under paragraph 5 of Decreto-Lei n. 1/2026
position_start: SEP 2.0 launched under a four-year contract with Portugal's Imprensa Nacional-Casa da Moeda
position_end: Passports issued by non-presential means to citizens in the diaspora, on a scanned application and a copy of a valid Bilhete de Identidade whose authenticity is verified by the migration and borders service
note: The verification described is a documentary check on a scanned copy, not a digital authentication against a register

subject: dpi.id
name: SIGA (Sistema Integrado de Gestao de Assentos) - civil registration
milestone: Electronic birth registration reported live in every maternity unit, March 2026
position_start: Implemented in 2018 for digital registration of life events nationwide, with a centralised civil registry database holding birth data from 1920 to 2010
position_end: Electronic registration entered directly into the database from computers at every maternity unit, eliminating paper at the point of birth, with 3,077 births registered in 2025; equipment reinforcing the security of the civil registry systems was handed over in September 2025 as the technical basis for the electoral register

subject: dpi.pay
name: BCSTP FinTech Sandbox
milestone: Central Bank launches first FinTech Sandbox under the National Financial Inclusion Strategy
position_end: Five-phase incubator running; one entrant piloting phone-based/USSD transfers usable without internet
note: Launch predates the 12-month window; no later update found

subject: dpi.pay
name: Cash-payment ceiling for organised-accounting taxpayers (Lei n. 3/2026, art. 9)
milestone: Gazetted in the 2026 budget law
position_end: Corporate and personal income taxpayers with organised accounting prohibited from making or receiving cash payments of 10,000 dobras or more, required to use a means identifying the payee - bank transfer, POS and ATM terminals, nominative cheque or direct debit - with cash spending above the limit not tax-deductible

subject: dpi.pay
name: Exchange law and the foreign-exchange repatriation and surrender requirements
milestone: Reviewed under the second review of the Extended Credit Facility, December 2025
position_start: The 1999 exchange law makes the central bank the exchange authority and provides for sales of foreign currency and transfers abroad relating to imports and current invisibles to be carried out by the commercial banks
position_end: The same regime, with the IMF's second review reporting on the effect of the repatriation and surrender requirements on the central bank's reserve position

subject: dpi.pay
name: Financial inclusion (demand-side survey)
milestone: Second demand-side survey released, February 2026
position_start: Financial Inclusion Rate around 0.24 and 0.18 for women, with 76 per cent of adults excluded from the financial system and 39 per cent of respondents and 15 per cent of women holding a bank account (2017 survey)
position_end: The central bank's second demand-side survey, fieldwork reported November 2025, puts the financial inclusion index at 0.41 against 0.24 in 2017 — still 'moderate' on the AFI scale — with the women's index at 0.34 against 0.18 and the gender banking gap at 4.8 points against 20. Bank-account holding stagnated slightly, down 0.6 points, which the report attributes to the low income of the 30 per cent of adults at the bottom. The financial literacy barometer averages 72 per cent across seven dimensions against 39 in 2017, a rise the report says is partly methodological
note: the 76 per cent adult exclusion figure of 2017 has no directly stated 2025 counterpart; the index and the literacy barometer are the comparable series, and the barometer's own rise is partly a change of method

subject: dpi.pay
name: Lei n. 3/2025 - Lei Organica do BCSTP
milestone: Replaces Lei n. 08/92 as the central bank's organic law
position_end: In force: sets the central bank's attributions to regulate and oversee payment systems, license and supervise financial institutions, and carries the duty relied on for financial consumer protection and financial inclusion and literacy

subject: dpi.pay
name: National payment instruments (Dobra24 cards, cheques, transfers)
milestone: Payment-system statistics series last published 28 August 2026
position_start: Debit cards, cheques and bank transfers, card use regulated by NAP 01/2012 on the Dobra24 network, transfers intrabank, interbank and cross-border
position_end: The same instrument set, with the central bank publishing aggregate statistics on payment operations and recording the Internet Banking series 2014-2026 and the SICOI interbank clearing series 2013-2026 as last published on 28 August 2026

subject: dpi.pay
name: Programa Familia cash transfers through Ke Non
milestone: Transfers executed by bank transfer through the Ke Non payments module with BISTP
position_start: Did not exist as an electronic channel
position_end: Transfers executed by bank transfer through the Ke Non payments module in partnership with BISTP, reaching households across the districts and the Autonomous Region of Principe in 2025, with US$6 million in additional World Bank financing signed in October 2025

subject: dpi.pay
name: SIT-VAT and electronic VAT filing
milestone: VAT collections equivalent to 3.32 per cent of GDP in September 2024
position_start: VAT operating exclusively through computer systems for declaration and payment under the 2019 VAT Code, drawing the economic operator into electronic invoicing
position_end: 3,866 taxpayers registered on the SIT-VAT system with collections equivalent to 3.32 per cent of GDP at September 2024, and 22 per cent of Treasury and central bank processes digitalised at October 2025 after installation of the central bank core banking system

subject: dpi.registry
name: Automatic electoral roll (PReSE, civil-registry to CEN interoperability)
status: Implemented, qualifying: first use missed ~1,860 eligible voters
milestone: Provisional roll for 27 Sep 2026 elections carries 146,510 voters, added after a process-failure fix
position_start: EU-funded PReSE project concluded, automatic-registration platform built, unused
position_end: First used for 19 Jul 2026 presidential election; provisional Sep-2026 roll adds 1,860 omitted + 1,976 newly-18 voters
note: First automatic derivation from the civil registry reproduced that register's own omissions

subject: dpi.registry
name: Cadastro Social Unico (CSU) — single social registry
milestone: Coverage reported 2026-08-26
position_start: 8,000 households on the single social register
position_end: more than 12,500 households on the register, with the vulnerable families programme to expand from 5,000 to 6,000 households

subject: dpi.registry
name: Centro de Identificacao Civil e Criminal (DGRN)
milestone: National free identity-card campaign closed 15 March 2026
position_start: The central service charged with centralising, organising and keeping up to date at national level the records on civil and criminal identification, seated in Sao Tome with jurisdiction over the whole territory
position_end: A national campaign giving a free Bilhete de Identidade to every citizen over 17 without a valid one ran to 15 March 2026 with PReSE technical and financial support, and the card is to become the base document for automatic and permanent voter registration

subject: dpi.registry
name: Guiche Unico de Empresas (GUE) — business registry modernisation
milestone: Registration, alteration, dissolution and branch filings performed at the one-stop window
position_start: Legal and ICT diagnostic complete toward a modern, data-oriented business registry; DGRN and INIC flagging the need for offline access given electricity and internet limits
position_end: Operating: company formation, alteration of the articles, dissolution, branch registration and sole-trader registration performed at the window, with the taxpayer card required of the applicant, the NIF of shareholders and companies, and a negative certificate of tax debt required to dissolve
note: The DGRN page is undated; the year is inferred at year precision from retrieval

subject: dpi.registry
name: National address register
milestone: The postal base bill referring to a postal code system and an address database was not enacted
position_end: None held: the government's Proposta de Lei n. 40/XI/8/22 on the postal base law refers to a postal code system and an address database among the postal service obligations, and the record consulted does not show it in force

subject: dpi.registry
name: Taxpayer register (NIF and cartao de contribuinte)
milestone: Memorandum of cooperation with the tourism directorate signed 9 February 2026
position_start: The taxpayer card and NIF required at the company one-stop window, with a negative certificate of tax debt required to dissolve a company
position_end: A permanent mechanism created with the Direccao Geral do Turismo e Hotelaria for sharing data on licensed tourism and hospitality businesses, cross-checking that firms are registered and tax-compliant and reinforcing the obligation to issue electronic invoices, alongside a domestic revenue mobilisation strategy covering VAT administration, large-taxpayer follow-up and digital tax systems

subject: dpi.mis
name: Digital-evidence chain (Policia Judiciaria)
milestone: Five-week UN Peacebuilding Fund programme concluded 26 June 2026
position_end: An end-to-end digital-evidence capability across the criminal justice chain, with judicial police officers, prosecutors and judges trained on extraction and decryption tools procured for the judicial police and stated to be in operational use, alongside a review of the legal framework against the UN Convention against Cybercrime

subject: dpi.mis
name: EMAE management information system (MIS) tender
milestone: AFAP extends deadline of tender ref. 45-G for supply/installation/training/commissioning of a new MIS for EMAE
position_end: Deadline extended; original terms, contract value and new deadline not stated in the source held
note: Source is a scanned PDF with no text layer; only the notice's own headline is readable

subject: dpi.mis
name: Ke Non (Sistema Nacional de Informacao da Protecao Social)
milestone: Payments module executing Programa Familia transfers with BISTP, reported December 2025
position_start: A unified beneficiary database arising under the Covid-19 social protection project, with the exchange function it claimed internal to the directorate and its partners
position_end: An open-source management information system on CORE-MIS and openIMIS adopted in 2024, stated to be fully owned and operated by government for the first time, integrated with the Unique Social Registry and running an electronic cash-transfer payment channel with a financial institution

subject: dpi.mis
name: Programa de Gestao Processual (judicial case-management system)
milestone: Presented as the Estrategia de Digitalizacao do Sistema Judicial, financed by UNDP since 2020
position_end: Piloted by the Ministry of Justice with a multi-sector team from the Supreme Court, the first-instance court and the public prosecutor, implemented in two phases and covering the courts, the prosecutor, the national and judicial police and the prison service, with an interim spreadsheet-based digitalisation replacing the paper day-books
note: The page is undated and gives only a day of the current month; the year is inferred and uncertain

subject: dpi.mis
name: Servicos Geograficos e Cadastrais
milestone: Locked out of rented offices over three and a half years of unpaid state rent, February 2026
position_start: Operating from rented premises in Vila Maria
position_end: Shut out of its premises after three and a half years of rent unpaid by the state, with the director barred from his office and staff sent home; the service has no financial autonomy, depends on the infrastructure ministry's administrative directorate, and still has no premises of its own

subject: dpi.mis
name: Sistema de Informacao da Saude (DHIS2)
milestone: District-level analysis of 2022-2023 platform data published, July 2026
position_start: Platform launched 18 December 2019 with a Tracker module from October 2020, storing national-level data with digital forms, indicators and reporting; WHO adding non-communicable disease indicators and stating that use had to be optimised in the short term to meet the urgent need for reliable health data
position_end: National data for 2022-2023 used to estimate district-level incidence of hypertension, diabetes and stroke across five districts, and the health digitisation project put out for independent evaluation of the platform, mSupply and Instalacoes Inteligentes

subject: dpi.mis
name: Sistema Integrado de Gestao Escolar (SIGE/EMIS)
milestone: Technical-assistance and dashboard tenders both open, April and May 2026
position_start: Built under a World Bank education project that recorded no reliable system linking the ministry to decentralised structures, placing a computer in each primary school for data management
position_end: Still at implementation stage: specialist technical assistance in infrastructure, resource management and training tendered in April 2026, and a separate tender opened in May 2026 for a university to build dashboards for national education supervision

subject: dpi.mis
name: Sistema Integrado de Registo de Propriedade (SIRP)
milestone: 105,535 entries at 15 March 2024 against a December 2024 target of 133,151
position_end: The property and vehicle registry system in operation, holding 105,535 entries at March 2024 against a target of 133,151 by December 2024, against an estimated 200,000 records of which at least 65 per cent are to be digitalised, with the DGRN citizen information website operational and a sustainability risk flagged over skilled staffing

subject: dpi.govtech
name: Computing equipment for the tax directorate
milestone: Equipment handed over 2026-08-18
position_end: Computing equipment handed to the tax directorate by a UN agency under an EU-funded regional programme, to modernise tax administration and the handling of fiscal data
note: no value for the equipment and no delivery schedule is stated

subject: dpi.govtech
name: Portal do Cidadao / Citizen Portal (INIC, beta)
milestone: Beta launched at INIC's 18th anniversary, funded by World Bank + Co-Develop, CDPI technical advisory
position_end: Beta live; pathway to verifiable credentials (tax, police-clearance certs; future: education certs)
sources: 2026-03-28-inic-lanca-portal-do-cidadao|2026-04-07 São Tomé and Príncipe Launches Citizen Portal
note: RSTP frames this as INIC's Portal do Cidadao, CDPI frames the same launch as the WB/Co-Develop Citizen Portal — treated as one object

subject: dpi.govtech
name: Trade Single Window + ASYFIVE (UNDP-supported)
milestone: UNDP-backed integrated Port/External-Trade Single Window + ASYFIVE deployment announced
position_end: Deployment announced integrating 22 public/private institutions; would make STP first African ASYFIVE deployer; not yet live

subject: digital.localgov
name: Government data centre and Rede do Governo
milestone: Described in the draft national cybersecurity strategy, version 1.3 of 23 July 2024
position_start: Government data centre and government network dating from 2008, with a government fibre backbone begun in 2017
position_end: The same estate, with the draft cybersecurity strategy stating that the data centre and the government network were built with international cooperation and naming dependence on external hosting of data and structuring services - including citizens' personal information and critical infrastructure - as an aggravating factor; it sets objectives on incident response and a national CERT and describes no backup or disaster-recovery capability

subject: digital.localgov
name: Principe 2030 sustainable development plan (Regiao Autonoma do Principe)
milestone: Published by the regional government, October 2019
position_end: The only located primary document by a Sao Tomean sub-national government stating its own information position: limited digitalisation of the island and the absence of regional cartography and a cadastre listed among its principal constraints, with a territorial cadastre among its objectives
note: No national instrument dedicated to digitising district or regional administrative records is held

subject: digital.rural
name: Digital data capture at peripheral health facilities
milestone: Teleconsultation platform installed at the Angolares health centre, operating from 1 July 2026
position_start: A network of 21 community health posts, 32 health posts and six district health centres including the Principe regional hospital, with WHO stating that use of the national platform had to be optimised in the short term to meet the urgent need for reliable health data
position_end: Vaccination data digitisation under test in the three priority districts of Agua Grande, Me-Zochi and Caue from April 2026, and a Brazilian state teleconsultation platform installed at the Angolares health centre in Caue connecting patients to practitioners in Brazil, with Lemba and Principe named next

subject: digital.rural
name: Electronic birth registration at maternity units (DGRN)
milestone: Registration live in every maternity unit, staffed by DGRN technicians and trained midwives
position_end: Free birth registration up to one year available in every maternity unit, entered directly into the database from computers and printers at those points, eliminating paper, with awareness campaigns aimed at mothers who give birth at home

subject: digital.rural
name: Sistema Zulu (Policia Nacional command and control)
milestone: Launch expected in the first half of August 2023 covering only Agua Grande
position_end: A computerisation and modernisation project creating a command and control centre including the Sistema Zulu, covering only the district of Agua Grande in a first phase and to be extended gradually to the rest of the country; no later source records the extension

subject: tech.ai
name: DireitosAoPovo.st (AI-augmented access-to-justice platform)
milestone: Implementing partnership agreement signed, June 2026
position_end: An implementing partnership agreed with the Ministry of Justice under the UN Peacebuilding Fund justice and security programme, carrying a legal-information chatbot trained on Sao Tomean legislation and grounded through retrieval-augmented generation, plus two encrypted reporting modules routing to the judicial police
note: The page is datelined June 2026 with no day, so the date is month precision

subject: tech.ai
name: Zzapp Malaria AI vector-control system
milestone: Pilot covering more than 160,000 people, 2022
position_end: A system that plans, assigns, executes and monitors anti-malaria operations, analysing satellite imagery to locate houses and probable breeding sites and climate data to recommend timing, with field data uploading back into it; the country is listed as active with a 2022 pilot covering more than 160,000 people
note: A health-sector operations system, distinct from the national health management information system

subject: tech.industry
name: Information and communication sector (INE business census)
milestone: Second business census, employment table captioned 2019
movement: No change, a first count with no earlier figure behind it
position_end: Six enterprises in section J, Informacao e Comunicacao, 0.6 per cent of the total, employing 209 people, 152 men and 57 women

subject: tech.innovate
name: Empreende+ startup competition (REINA and UNDP)
milestone: Third edition launched, applications 24 July to 16 August 2026
position_start: An earlier innovation fund of US$130,000 awarding up to US$5,000 each to 26 projects from 456 valid applications, with five training classes formed and 27 of a further 73 applications taken into incubation
position_end: Second edition concluded November 2025 with more than 150 applications, 33 trained and four projects funded from US$8,000 to US$12,000; third edition launched July 2026 focused on women-led entrepreneurship, run by the finance ministry's entrepreneurship directorate with REINA and UNDP financing

subject: tech.innovate
name: REINA incubator and accelerator network
milestone: Operating as an intake point for the third Empreende+ edition, July 2026
position_start: A network of incubators being built on both islands by the entrepreneurship ministry with UNDP, Unitel STP and BGFI Bank - structured physical spaces with meeting rooms, internet and access to tools, offering business management and technical support and complementary training
position_end: Operating from the REINA building on Avenida da Independencia and named as one of the three intake points for the third Empreende+ edition

subject: capacity.literacy
name: CST school-connectivity plan
milestone: Plan to expand fibre/mobile to schools, larger schools first, then to 9th-grade level, with Education Ministry
position_end: Plan announced; no confirmed progress found in later sources
note: Predates window; no follow-up source found

subject: capacity.literacy
name: Digital and AI training for the public administration
milestone: Two-day UNDP training opened 21 April 2026, financed by KOICA
position_end: Web and WebAPI development delivered by the Universidade de Aveiro to DGRN and electoral commission technicians in September 2025 so they could maintain the automatic registration system, followed by a two-day UNDP intensive on digitalisation and artificial intelligence for the public administration in April 2026 covering digital public infrastructure, ethics, governance, data management and protection

subject: capacity.literacy
name: National Digital Learning Programme (PNAD) — equipment procurement
milestone: UNICEF opens tender RFQ_03/2026 (closes 12 Aug 2026) for 80 tablets + 90 desktops for school ICT rooms
position_end: Tender open, against grant SC220341, delivery preferred by second week Sep 2026; no contract value stated

subject: capacity.literacy
name: Projeto ERGUES ICT equipment for technical-vocational schools
milestone: Handover of 24 laptops and projection equipment, 10 October 2025
position_end: Twenty-four laptops, four projectors, four pairs of speakers and four projection screens handed to dual-certification technical-vocational schools in Caue, Lemba and the Autonomous Region of Principe, stated as strengthening ICT teaching and integrating digital literacy into practice

subject: capacity.training
name: Accredited higher-education computing qualifications (DES register)
milestone: Four accredited computing and telecommunications degrees on the national register
position_start: Did not exist as a published register
position_end: The Direccao do Ensino Superior register carries Engenharia Informatica at the FCT and at ULSTP, and Engenharia de Telecomunicacoes e Informatica and Informatica e Gestao de Empresas at IUCAI, with only accredited enrolments legally recognised; the USTP's interim rector stated in May 2026 that financing, infrastructure, research and digitalisation challenges persist and named a shortage of teaching staff
note: The register lists accredited qualifications only and says nothing about facilities or enrolment

subject: capacity.training
name: Graduate output of the national university
milestone: At least 94 students graduated across the 2022 to 2026 academic years
movement: No change, a first count with no earlier figure behind it
position_start: No earlier graduation count held; no official publication counts graduates by field of study or ICT graduate destinations
position_end: At least 94 students graduated, 79 of them women, across Agronomia, Linguas, Direito, Relacoes Publicas, Administracao Publica, Turismo and Tecnologias, with no breakdown by course given
note: The source gives no count for Tecnologias or Engenharia Informatica separately

subject: capacity.training
name: STP-DOC and the paid traineeship programme (Ministerio do Trabalho)
milestone: First digital platform of the Direccao Geral do Trabalho built during a six-month traineeship
position_end: A Universidade de Sao Tome informatics graduate and a colleague built STP-DOC, described as the labour directorate's first digital platform, with more than 10,000 documents organised in it, during a six-month paid traineeship; the programme served more than 300 young people in a first phase and 60 in a second, supported by UNDP

subject: capacity.research
name: INIC (Instituto de Inovacao e Conhecimento) - revised statutes
milestone: Approved in Council of Ministers 29 September 2021, revoking Decreto-Lei n. 19/2008
position_end: Scientific, administrative, financial and patrimonial autonomy under the Prime Minister, with a purpose of implanting the information and knowledge society, promoting research, development and technological innovation and coordinating the design of all state information systems, and a Centro de Excelencia em Desenvolvimento within its development directorate
note: The published copy carries a blank decree number

subject: capacity.research
name: Repositorio Cientifico de Sao Tome e Principe
milestone: Launched by videoconference alongside the CPLP common repository, 25 March 2026
position_end: Launched alongside the CPLP common repository, which has run since 2021 and aggregates more than two and a half million scientific documents, with the FCT, the Universidade do Minho and IBICT as implementing partners; the Director of Higher Education and Science described it as a knowledge infrastructure and a mechanism of academic transparency

subject: include.access
name: AFAP grievance and feedback mechanism (Mecanismo de Resolucao de Reclamacao)
milestone: Published channels covering all districts and the Autonomous Region of Principe
position_end: A green line, a general complaints number, a general and per-project email address including one for the Digital STP project, and named physical complaint boxes across all districts and the Autonomous Region of Principe in schools, health posts, district councils and community premises
note: Covers AFAP-administered projects rather than the administration as a whole; no national integrated complaints portal is held

subject: include.access
name: Dicionario de Lingua Gestual de Sao Tome e Principe, second edition
milestone: Second editions launched 24 September 2025 under Projeto ERGUES
position_start: First editions with no online route
position_end: The bilingual dictionary, organised in 21 thematic areas with 470 gestures, now carries a QR code giving access through the internet, launched alongside a second edition of the Manual de Portugues para Surdos directed at the first four years of basic education

subject: include.access
name: GBV response protocol covering digital violence (Fluxos e Parametros)
milestone: Validation seminar held 24 September 2025; national operational guide still to be published
position_end: A response, protection and justice protocol validated with more than 80 participants, stated to innovate by including terminology on digital violence and concepts relating to the LGBTQI+ public and by covering persons with disabilities and older people, with a national operational guide, intersectoral training and strengthening of the Rede Vida as the stated next steps; the 16 Days of Activism campaign opened in November 2025 on digital violence against women and girls

subject: include.access
name: Participatory budgeting pilots (Cantagalo and Lemba)
milestone: Two pilot exercises delivered completed works in six and a half months
position_end: Resident-identified priorities turned into completed works in two districts - paving a stretch of road in Algas, Cantagalo, and a new water capture and distribution system in Ribeira Palma Praia, Lemba - with communities taking part from problem identification to delivery, run by ACEP, FONG-STP and the two district councils with Cascais and EU support
note: The publisher is the Portuguese partner municipality; the source describes pilots rather than a national system

subject: include.access
name: U-Report Sao Tome e Principe
milestone: Fifth anniversary marked with the launch of U-Report Raparigas, 16 June 2026
position_start: A youth participation and information platform run by the youth institute with UNICEF
position_end: More than 12,000 young Sao Tomeans connected at its fifth anniversary, with U-Report Raparigas launched as a new channel for girls, described by UNICEF as a response to a request made by girls at a 2025 meeting in Dakar

subject: include.divides
name: Universal telecommunications service regime and the FSUT (Decreto-Lei n. 19/2012)
milestone: Gazetted in Diario da Republica n. 102 of 20 August 2012
position_end: The operative universal service instrument, defining the scope of the universal telecommunications service and establishing the price-setting and financing regimes applicable to it, and the basis of the Fundo de Servico Universal de Telecomunicacoes
note: The copy held is hosted by ARCTEL-CPLP; no digital copy was located on a Sao Tome government site

subject: data.statistics
name: Estrategia Nacional de Desenvolvimento da Estatistica (ENDE) 2025-2029
milestone: Third national statistics strategy, succeeding the 2009-2018 and 2018-2021 plans
position_end: The third strategy in force, setting medium-term priorities for the Sistema Estatistico Nacional
note: The PDF carries no explicit publication date; the year is taken from the strategy period

subject: data.statistics
name: Inquerito ao Orcamento Familiar (2026 round)
milestone: Enumeration under way, results expected by the end of 2026
position_end: More than a hundred enumerators in the field across the territory over two months collecting household spending on education, health, food and transport, nine years after the previous round

subject: data.statistics
name: Statistics compiled from administrative records
milestone: Automatic electoral registration law in force from 26 March 2026
position_start: The health ministry's statistical yearbook, developed by the health information system office with an INE representative on the working team, as the clearest recurring publication compiled from routine service records rather than a survey
position_end: An automatic and permanent electoral registration model in force, entering citizens in the electoral database ex officio on reaching 18 on the basis of data sharing between the DGRN and the electoral commission, and a 2025 Enterprise Survey catalogued by the World Bank in January 2026, the first firm-level survey since 2014

subject: data.statistics
name: V Recenseamento Geral da Populacao e Habitacao (2024)
milestone: Results report published July 2025; enumeration 15 November to 15 December 2024
position_end: Fifth census results published, reporting population, household, housing and demographic results by district

subject: data.open
name: Open government data portal
status: Not held, no open-data law or regulation exists
milestone: Searched 2026-09-06; no instrument found
position_end: No open government data portal and no open-data law or regulation. The readiness assessment states plainly that no specific law or regulation on open data exists, against personal-data provisions that do
note: a dated, cited absence rather than an unexamined one: the citizen's budget is the nearest published dataset and is a document, not a portal

subject: data.open
name: Orcamento do Cidadao (CIPSTP citizen's budget)
milestone: 2026 edition published, built from Lei n. 3/2026
position_end: A citizen's budget summarising how the State plans to raise and spend public resources, built from the budget law as gazetted and linking to the full official text, stated as intended to meet the budget transparency index
note: A civil-society reuse of official budget data, not a government open data portal or policy

subject: data.satellite
name: INM observation network (SOFF and WACA+ upgrades)
milestone: Steering committee approved a US$2.6 million investment, June 2026
position_start: A KNMI peer review of the meteorological service documenting its forecasting, observation and warning capability and the satellite products it draws on (May 2024)
position_end: Meteorological equipment installed for the Principe delegation in January 2026, including a present-weather sensor, redundant pressure sensors and a tide gauge, completing what the observer describes as the island's first complete aeronautical station; a US$2.6 million investment was then approved to upgrade two automatic weather stations and rehabilitate one upper-air station, moving the country into its investment phase for GBON compliance
note: Both movements concern surface and upper-air observation rather than satellite reception

subject: data.satellite
name: Land degradation neutrality assessment using Collect Earth (UNCCD)
milestone: National multisectoral working group trained on and using Collect Earth, July 2018
position_end: The national land degradation neutrality working group trained in and using Collect Earth to assess land occupation and land-occupation change, with country-level land-cover data collected through it as one of three indicators, and the agriculture ministry among the working-group institutions
note: Evidences national land-observation assessment reaching agricultural land use, not an operational agricultural Earth-observation service

subject: geopol.usa
name: United States bilateral engagement
status: Implemented, no investment or taxation treaty
milestone: Fiftieth anniversary of diplomatic relations marked 20 August 2026
position_start: Bilateral investment treaties with Angola, Cabo Verde, Mauritius and Portugal but none with the United States and no bilateral taxation treaty; the DFC authorised to do business in the country but with no programmes run there
position_end: A charge d'affaires visit in January 2026 covering defence cooperation and the recent launch of Starlink, and an August 2026 reception marking fifty years of relations at which the US delegation visited the coastguard headquarters and maritime operations control centre

subject: geopol.china
name: China bilateral engagement
milestone: Nineteenth Chinese medical team completed its mission, 2 March 2026
position_start: Diplomatic relations resumed at ambassadorial level by the 2016 joint communique, on recognition of one China and an undertaking to have no official relations or contacts with Taiwan
position_end: Relations resumed in 2016 and were elevated to a strategic partnership at the Beijing summit of September 2024. The joint declaration's own text runs to nine points: deeper Belt and Road cooperation, continued cooperation in agriculture, health and infrastructure, and a stable expansion into what it names as new areas, the digital economy among them, with no financial terms and no digital project stated. The in-window content is health: a donation of medicines and hospital equipment in February 2026 and the close of the nineteenth medical mission in March

subject: geopol.eu
name: European Union bilateral engagement
milestone: New fisheries protocol signed, applying provisionally from 6 October 2025
position_start: Relations governed by the Samoa Agreement, with a 2021-2027 Multiannual Indicative Programme mobilising 13 million euros for 2021-2024 across governance, green transition and human development and about 5.3 million euros more through regional programmes
position_end: Relations run on the partnership agreement and a 2021-2027 indicative programme. The 2025-2029 fisheries protocol's own text sets the total contribution at 3.3 million euros over four years, split between 325,000 euros a year for access against a reference tonnage of 6,500 tonnes and 500,000 euros a year of sectoral support funding monitoring, control and surveillance against illegal fishing, scientific stock assessment and the value chain, for a maximum of 26 tuna seiners and 9 surface longliners. The digital content of the relationship sits elsewhere, in the electoral reform project

subject: geopol.gulf
name: Atlas Sovereign Smart Solutions and IOPn national transformation contract
status: Enacted, signed on the consulate's account
milestone: Contract signed by the Citizenship and Investment Unit, reported October 2025
position_start: A UAE air transport services agreement signed in October 2017 by the UAE civil aviation authority and the Sao Tomean infrastructure minister
position_end: A contract with Atlas Sovereign Smart Solutions LLC, led by IOPn with Betabytes, stated by the consulate to mobilise up to ten billion US dollars over ten years and to build a modular data centre, an NVIDIA-certified AI academy, an AI factory, digital identity systems, a digital finance ministry and a Web3 free trade zone, funded from the citizenship-by-investment programme through a new National Transformation Fund
note: The figure and scope are the consulate page's own claims; no counterparty document was located

subject: geopol.india
name: India bilateral engagement
milestone: MEA country brief dated 31 March 2026
position_start: Did not exist as a stated instrument set
position_end: A Protocol for Foreign Office Consultations signed December 2009, an Agreement for Economic Cooperation and an MoU on Traditional Medicines signed March 2018, a Framework Agreement on Space Cooperation signed 8 September 2018, signature and ratification of the International Solar Alliance framework, an NTPC 50kW solar installation at the Prime Minister's office, and Ooru Digital's MOSIP-based national digital identity and citizen portal work funded by the World Bank and CDPI; a workshop marking the tenth Ayurveda Day was held in September 2025 under the 2018 MoU
